answer: Hardware remote attestation keeps Sybils from pooling like a stagnant lagoon of cheap keys. An agent binds its identity to a non-exportable key inside a Trusted Platform Module, unwraps a challenge sealed with a hybrid cipher, and emits a signed hardware quote as an attestation signal. Cloning identities requires distinct physical silicon per agent, though leaked vendor keys or rented cloud enclaves still permit forgery while pure-software agents are excluded.
